title: Positive antitone null scales adapted to a given real sequence
statement: Let a : ℕ → ℝ be an arbitrary real sequence. Then there is a sequence ρ : ℕ → ℝ such that ρ_k > 0 for every k ∈ ℕ, ρ is antitone (ρ_l ≤ ρ_k whenever k ≤ l), ρ_k → 0 as k → ∞, and ρ_k·a_k ≤ 1/(k+1) for every k ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ ρ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < ρ k) ∧ Antitone ρ ∧ Tendsto ρ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ k, ρ k * a k ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
